Level 3 dagger strings, level 6 Death Lotus, first item one-shot threshold, late-game flank. Her only counter-clock is Light Binding at a flat 10s and Final Spark at 60/50/40s.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no digit despite Light Binding being the single tracked ability. Two bullet bodies were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles. The brief's missing interaction — Lux's combo opening with an Illumination auto-attack reset, so the wind-up rather than the spell cast is the tell — was absent everywhere.
audit.why: Light Binding is the only interrupt in her kit and it is a flat 10s at every rank at 1175 range; it hits up to two units, so a caster minion in the line absorbs it. Final Spark is a damage steroid with no CC, so it cannot stop Death Lotus once you are on top of her. Illumination carries the autoReset flag.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now carries Light Binding flat 10s at 1175, Lucent Singularity 10s at rank 1 and Final Spark 60s with the note that it cannot stop a channel. The minion-block interaction is stated in dosFull[0].d, the auto-reset tell in breakdown.mid.
